standard_prerequisites.name: Strongly cartesian morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Fix the strong cartesian condition and the uniqueness of strongly cartesian lifts used in the converse.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of strongly cartesian morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes that beta = beta' o iota is strongly cartesian in the converse direction.

core_obligations: Prove the characterization: (a, beta) is strongly cartesian in u^pS iff beta is strongly cartesian in S.
Forward direction: expand Mor sets in u^pS as fibre products over Mor_D and use the strong cartesian property of beta to factor the displayed chain of identifications.
Converse: compare two strongly cartesian lifts of a over u(a); uniqueness gives an isomorphism iota with beta = beta' o iota, and composition transfers strong cartesianness to beta.
Existence: given (U', y') and U -> U', lift u(U) -> u(U') by a strongly cartesian morphism in S and transport it through the characterization.
proof_roadmap: Prove the strong-cartesian characterization by a Mor-set computation one way and a uniqueness-of-lifts argument the other way, then deduce existence of lifts.
difficulty_reason: The characterization needs a four-line Mor-set fibre-product computation in one direction and a uniqueness-of-strongly-cartesian-lifts argument in the other, plus the existence consequence.
